thread:
marta-docs: Quick sync  I pushed a tiny docs change that standardizes SOC2 language in the audit-log retention page and adds v2 SDK examples (py/ts/curl). Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/6012

sam-security: Thanks. Two quick requests: 1) remove casual verbs like 'we keep' and 2) add a short line that exported datasets are gated by RBAC and audit logs.

marta-docs: Current phrasing: 'We keep customer audit logs for 90 days; exports may be kept longer for compliance.' Want to change to something SOC2-friendly.

sam-security: Suggest: 'Customer audit logs are retained for 90 days by default. Exports created to satisfy legal or contractual obligations may be retained longer; exported data is subject to role-based access controls and audit trails.'

eli-eng: Added three examples in the PR for v2 SDK surface. Python snippet (sync): ```python
from redwood_v2 import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.query_events({"sample":0.005, "start":"2025-01-01", "end":"2025-02-01"})
print(resp["count"])
```

eli-eng: TS example (promise): ```ts
import { AuditClient } from '@redwood/inference-v2'
const c = new AuditClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
c.queryEvents({ sample: 0.005, start: '2025-01-01', end: '2025-02-01' }).then(r => console.log(r.count))
```

eli-eng: Curl one-liner for ops: ``curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/query -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"sample":0.005,"start":"2025-01-01","end":"2025-02-01"}'``

nora-legal: Legal note: prefer the phrase 'as required by law or contractual obligations' and add legal-hold contact: legal@redwood.com. Also add a short sentence that example IDs are pseudonymized.

marta-docs: Added legal contact and pseudonymization example: `{"user_id":"sha256:fa34...","event":"model.call","ts":"2025-02-14T09:00:00Z"}`

sam-security: Add a short callout about sampling bias: sampled queries are useful for triage but can miss rare events; recommend a full export for investigations. Also request a tiny line about retention override process (who to contact).

marta-docs: Done  added contact links and the bias callout. I'll wait for one formal LGTM from security + legal before merging. CI bot: please run linkcheck on merge. :eyes:
